title: Round 18 four-view starter reference adaptation and ASE verification
summary: Prepared Vera's existing Starter A turnaround as FOUR independently aligned 128x256 source-derived RGBA sprite views, sharing a 74-color opaque palette, hard alpha, matching y=248 soles and top y=11, exported a 512x256 four-direction sheet and constructed a 4-frame/3-layer 32bpp ASE. Independently parsed every ASE cel and verified lossless compositing matches the four PNGs. This does NOT represent new hand-drawn character art, an animation, a LibreSprite-open test of this specific proprietary file, or production-ready sprites. The source images and derived assets remain private in conversation downloads; only method/metrics are public. Next study should tackle genuinely independent pixel-art armor design; keep all former animation/glitch/overgrowth coursework.
